mainsection.title: Back for Good
mainsection.plot: With Green Lantern's help, and the sacrifice of an old enemy, the original Superman is restored to full power, ready to duke it out with Hank Henshaw in the final faceoff.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st app. of Steel, 1st app. of Superboy

mainsection.title: Steel
mainsection.plot: Another successor to Superman is introduced. John Henry Irons felt he owed his life to Superman, and now he has built a suit of armour to help continue fighting the good fight. His first task is to go after weapons dealers in the neighborhood, though his reaction to them clearly indicates that he has some sort of a history with them.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st full app. and origin of Steel

mainsection.title: Boy Meets Girl
mainsection.plot: Superboy is playing hero and playing for the cameras when Supergirl arrives to invite him to dinner. At that dinner, Lex proposes a business arrangement, but before the oral agreement can be ratified on paper, Superboy is swayed into signing an exclusive elsewhere. Before he can explain this to Lex, he's caught in an attack that may have been scheduled for the sake of TV ratings.

mainsection.title: Part 13: Lies & Revelations
mainsection.plot: The Cyborg Superman tortures Superboy, with hopes of manipulating him in the future. He continues to plan with Mongul to destroy Metropolis much as he destroyed Coast City, but there are forces in motion which may be enough to stop it.

comic.keycomicreason: The Last Son of Krypton becomes the Eradicator

mainsection.title: Part 1: Potential
mainsection.plot:
ALL-NEW ARC! Enter: ARMORINES!
Armor Hunters was only the beginning! Now, still reeling from his harrowing encounter with the Armor Hunters, Aric of Dacia might face a new threat – the calculating paramilitary force known as the ARMORINES! Armed with an array of astounding abilities far beyond the capabilities of the X-O Manowar armor, has this bleeding-edge commando unit come to save Aric’s kingdom…or grind it into dust? Find out as Valiant superstars Robert Venditti and Diego Bernard unleash a pivotal new chapter in the saga of X-O Manowar!

mainsection.title: Part 4: Slow Burn
mainsection.plot:
Broken kingdom!
The world has changed for Aric of Dacia – the armored earthbound hero known as X-O Manowar. Unable to protect his friends and allies from the interstellar hunters sworn to kill him, the Visigoth warrior who would be king now recoils from the horrendous consequences – even as a threatening new future looms. Everything changes now!

mainsection.title: Part 1: Tall Tales
mainsection.plot:
ARMOR HUNTERS unleashes an all-new starting point for the world’s most wanted hero – X-O Manowar – right here with a brand new story arc by Robert Venditti (Green Lantern, The Flash) and Diego Bernard (Eternal Warrior)!
Abducted from his own time by a vicious alien race, the courageous Visigoth warrior known as Aric of Dacia spent years in slavery among the stars before escaping with his captors’ most feared weapon – the X-O Manowar armor. Now, stranded in the modern day, the world’s most primitive man also just happens to wield its most powerful weapon. But what is the X-O Manowar armor? And who before Aric of Dacia dared to wield its incalculable power? The ARMOR HUNTERS hold the key to the armor’s untold history and – one way or another – they’ll crush anything that dares threaten their secret.
*RETAILERS BE ADVISED: Due to the lead time needed to produce chromium, Armor Hunters Chromium Editions will be available in robust but limited quantities set prior to solicitation, and orders may be allocated.

mainsection.title: The Origin of X-O Manowar / The Fate of Kings / Burial / Unity Pin-Up / Shanhara's Day Off / Bar Fight / X-O Manowar Database / Battle For The Ages / X-O Manowar Pin-Up
mainsection.plot:
VALIANT FIRST delivers another must-read milestone this May with a blockbuster, 48-page celebration of X-O Manowar’s 25th issue…and an essential introduction to the comic book event of 2014 – ARMOR HUNTERS!
Find out why the galaxy’s most feared team of hunter-killers have journeyed across the stars to destroy the X-O Manowar armor and the Earth along with it in ARMOR HUNTERS: PART ZERO by Robert Venditti and Diego Bernard. Then, revisit the roots of Aric of Dacia’s transformation from Visigoth conqueror into the 21st century’s alien-armored guardian, as told by Robert Venditti and J.G. Jones! Plus, all-new tales of X-O Manowar from Peter Milligan & Bryan Hitch, Justin Jordan & Rafer Roberts, and much, much more!

mainsection.title: Part 2: Diplomacy
mainsection.plot:
PRELUDE TO ARMOR HUNTERS – PART 2! Who – or what – is the man called MALGAM?
Aric of Dacia, a fifth-century warrior bonded to alien armor and transplanted to the modern day, is now the most important weapon in the arsenal of M.E.R.O., the top-secret American intelligence organization that monitors extraterrestrial life on Earth. In order to protect his people, Aric must undergo dangerous missions in space, but nothing can prepare him for the stunning secret that awaits him in the stars. The march toward X-O Manowar #25 – and the coming of the ARMOR HUNTERS – continues here in an essential prelude to the Valiant Universe event of 2014!

mainsection.title: Part 4: The Price Of Peace
mainsection.plot:
UNITY EPILOGUE! When X-O Manowar thought he had finally found peace, he instead found only more war, death, and destruction…
Now, at his lowest point, Aric of Dacia’s fate rests in the hands with the most unlikely of allies. Will X-O Manowar regain his lost power and seek bloody vengeance on his enemies, or will be forge a new path? The beginning of a brand new era for Valiant’s flagship hero starts here.

mainsection.title: Part 2: Control
mainsection.plot:
UNITY TIE-IN! Head-to-head with Toyo Harada and the forces of UNITY!
X-O Manowar finally has it all, and his people finally have a land they can call home…but threats from all sides now threaten to destroy Aric and the peace he has struggled to secure. While unrest stirs and Aric’s camp threatens to rebel against him, the most dangerous strike force ever assembled – UNITY – have joined forces with the Harbinger Foundation’s Toyo Harada to achieve but one goal: kill Aric of Dacia. Robert Venditti and Cary Nord ratchet up their standalone story arc at the heart of the year’s biggest comic book event!

mainsection.title: Part 1: Challenges
mainsection.plot:
All-new arc, all-new jumping-on point! X-O Manowar goes head-to-head against the forces of UNITY!
Aric of Dacia has fought to reclaim the ancestral lands of the Visigoths – and he has bled for it. But nothing he has faced before can prepare him for the combined might of UNITY – and the deadly combination of Harada, Ninjak, Eternal Warrior and Livewire! New York Times best-selling writer Robert Venditti (Green Lantern) and Eisner Award winner Cary Nord (X-O Manowar: Planet Death) reunite for a landmark, standalone story arc at the heart of UNITY.

mainsection.title: Part 3
mainsection.plot:
Part 3 of the explosive PLANET DEATH mega-event!
Aric discovers the Vine he intends conquer aren’t the only race on planet Loam, but will these surprise inhabitants offer him refuge or rivalry? Meanwhile, the Vine leaders plan their most devastating attack yet, one that will push the X-O Manowar armor to its limits and beyond. The stakes are raised and the table set for the epic battle from which no one—human or Vine—will emerge unchanged.

mainsection.title: Part 4: Vauxhall Cross
mainsection.plot:
X-O Manowar and Ninjak unearth The Vine’s ultimate endgame!
Deep within the halls of the MI-6, a sinister plot by The Vine’s alien agents is about to come to fruition. Their goal? Wipe humanity off the map – beginning with X-O Manowar. To get the job done, The Vine has enlisted Ninjak, the world’s most lethal assassin, but by doing so, they may have sealed their own fate. What began as a war between two men must become an uneasy truce…or Earth will fall.

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: Aric of Dacia has bonded with the most powerful weapon in the universe, but his command of the sentient X-O Manowar armor will lead him to cross swords with Ninjak, the world’s most skilled weapons specialist. Hired by members of The Vine hidden deep within Earth’s governments, Ninjak has been sent to bring back the Manowar armor at any cost. It’s raw power versus stealth and cunning in the second installment of the espionage-edged thriller that pits two of Valiant’s most popular heroes against each other – to the death.

mainsection.title: Part 1: Clandestine Gatherings
mainsection.plot: Jump on board the smash hit series of the summer as two Valiant legends collide for the ?rst time! The X-O Manowar armor has fallen to Earth - and now the world's most lethal intelligence agent has a new target. But who is the operative known as Ninjak? And who - or what - has marked Aric of Dacia for death by his blade? Find out as the all-new Ninjak makes his shocking ?rst appearance - and cuts his way to the forefront of the Valiant Universe.

mainsection.title: Part 4: Then & Now
mainsection.plot: With the enormous power of the X-O Manowar armor at his command, Aric has returned to Earth hell bent on destroying the Roman Empire. But the Rome he encounters is as alien to him as the Vine colony ship he escaped from -- because 1,600 years have transpired in his absence. Without fully understanding the consequences of his actions, will Aric's first act in the modern day ignite a new world war? Meanwhile, the secret history of the Vine's presence on Earth is finally revealed. Who is corporate mogul Alexander Dorian? Will he be Aric's one ally in this strange new world -- or his very first enemy?

mainsection.title: Part 4: Slow Burn
mainsection.plot:
Broken kingdom!
The world has changed for Aric of Dacia – the armored earthbound hero known as X-O Manowar. Unable to protect his friends and allies from the interstellar hunters sworn to kill him, the Visigoth warrior who would be king now recoils from the horrendous consequences – even as a threatening new future looms. Everything changes now!

mainsection.title: Part 3: Among The Living
mainsection.plot:
From across the void…the true history of the Armor Hunters revealed!
In the far reaches of deep space, an elite and hardened corps of soldiers has protected the galaxy by eliminating one unparalleled threat – a plague of X-O Manowar armors that has driven the universe to the brink of madness. Now, for the first time, Robert Venditti opens the vault to reveal the stunning secret of the Armor Hunters – who they are, where they come from, and why a terrible secret from their past now threatens the present!

mainsection.title: Part 2: A Call To Arms
mainsection.plot:
Hunt it. Trap it. Kill it.
The Armor Hunters are the most dangerous fighters in the universe – unparalleled in their abilities to catch and destroy their prey. Their mission has been long and unforgiving…and has featured the destruction of many X-O Manowar armors. For the first time, we see the brutal beginnings of the Hunters…and the devastation they have vowed to combat.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: ALL-NEW ARC, ALL-NEW JUMPING-ON POINT! X-O Manowar VERSUS the Eternal Warrior! Aric of Dacia returns to Earth after the events of Planet Death with his mind set on reclaiming the ancestral lands of his people. The code of a fifth century Visigoth is about to clash with the militaries of the modern world, and the only one who may be able to convince Aric to stand down is someone from his past - Gilad Anni-Padda, the Eternal Warrior. Artist Lee Garbett (X-O Manowar: Enter Ninjak!) reteams with writer Robert Venditti for a brand-new arc that will set the stage for X-O Manowar's next year in the Valiant Universe.

mainsection.title: Part 4
mainsection.plot:
He has conquered. He has killed. But can he reign over PLANET DEATH?
Aric of Dacia came to Loam to exact his revenge against the alien race that captured and tortured his people. Now, Aric must make a choice that will affect both him and the future of the Valiant Universe forever. Don’t miss the jaw-dropping conclusion of PLANET DEATH and this monumental moment for the ongoing saga of X-O Manowar!

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot:
What lurks beneath the surface of PLANET DEATH?
Aric of Dacia has taken his one-man war to the Vine’s homeworld, Loam, and is using their own X-O Manowar armor to wage it. Finding an ally in the unlikeliest of places, Aric will discover that his mission to reduce Loam to ash will come with a high price. Past, present, and future are about to collide, and if Aric isn’t careful, he will be the common thread that undoes them all.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot:
ALL-NEW ARC! PLANET DEATH has arrived! X-O Manowar’s one-man invasion of the Vine’s alien homeworld starts here!
At long last, Aric of Dacia will take his revenge on the alien race that have pursued him at every turn. As his Visigoth forefathers sacked Rome, so too will Aric of Dacia bring a devastating assault to the doorstep of his oppressors. Taking the battle directly to the Vine planet of Loam, he will decimate their armies, he will level their cities – and he will not stop until the whole of their empire is reduced to ash. But when one man declares war on an entire world, what painful consequences will he reap for himself – and for the whole of human race?

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: The countdown to PLANET DEATH starts now! The Vine invasion fleet has finally reached Earth, and they aren’t leaving until they reclaim their sacred X-O Manowar armor. Standing in their path is Aric of Dacia, the first human to ever wield the armor’s power. But the armor is capable of so much more than even Aric knows and he’ll face adversaries old and new in his battle to save humanity from extinction. The war begins here!

mainsection.title: Part 3
mainsection.plot: X-O Manowar vs. Ninjak. To the victor – Earth! Agents of the alien race known as The Vine have been living in secret among us for centuries and now they’ve just been activated for one final mission – purge the Earth of all human life! An invasion fleet is on its way and the only weapon in existence powerful enough to defeat it is the X-O Manowar armor. But first, Aric of Dacia must survive his latest encounter with Ninjak, the covert operative and master weapons specialist charged with taking him down.

mainsection.title: Part 4: Then & Now
mainsection.plot: With the enormous power of the X-O Manowar armor at his command, Aric has returned to Earth hell bent on destroying the Roman Empire. But the Rome he encounters is as alien to him as the Vine colony ship he escaped from -- because 1,600 years have transpired in his absence. Without fully understanding the consequences of his actions, will Aric's first act in the modern day ignite a new world war? Meanwhile, the secret history of the Vine's presence on Earth is finally revealed. Who is corporate mogul Alexander Dorian? Will he be Aric's one ally in this strange new world -- or his very first enemy?

edition.displayname: Cvr B 20 Copy Incentive Var Kramer

mainsection.title: Part 3: The Road to Rome
mainsection.plot: With the X-O Manowar armor now in his possession, all that stands between Aric and freedom is a legion of alien soldiers. When he at last comes face to face with Commander Trill - the man responsible for his capture - the enormous power of the Manowar armor reveals its potential in a new and electrifying way. Can Aric lead his band of fellow prisoners off the Vine colony ship and back to Earth, or will their revolt be put down? Who will live, and who will die?

mainsection.title: Part 2: Escaping Eden
mainsection.plot: Held captive by the alien species known as the Vine, Aric of Dacia must survive the brutal pens of a massive ship is he has any chance to return to Rome to free his family. Joining forces with the other prisoners, he devises a scheme to get hsi hangs on the only weapon that can free him: the X-O Manowar armor! He'll need every ounce of his Vigigoth courage and warrior's training, but all his efforts may be in vain, because the armor's history holds a dark secret, one that could be Aric's undoing!

mainsection.title: Part 1: Blades and Open Fields
mainsection.plot: It's the comic book event a decade in the making! The all-new Valiant Universe kicks off with a landmark, oversized # 1 issue of X-O Manowar by New York Times-bestselling author Robert Venditti (The Surrogates, The Homeland Directive) and Eisner Award-winning artist Cary Nord (Conan)! Born into battle, Aric of Dacia -- heir to the throne of the Visigoth people -- has never known peace. After a brutal encounter with a mysterious enemy known as The Vine leaves him a prisoner on an incomprehensible world, the only hope Aric has of returning to his family and saving them from slavery is to seize a weapon of incalculable destruction and become X-O Manowar! The Vine destroyed Aric's world. Now he will give them war.

mainsection.title: Part 3: On Dead Ground
mainsection.plot:
DEAD HAND descends on X-O Manowar!
He may wield the universe’s most powerful weapon, but not even X-O Manowar is enough to combat the unstoppable doomsday protocol called Dead Hand. To defeat this mighty army, Aric will need some might of his own…and an unlikely ally might be the key to victory! Robert Venditti (ARMOR HUNTERS, The Flash) and Diego Bernard (Red Lanterns) continue the modern epic DEAD HAND!

mainsection.title: What Lies Beyond
mainsection.plot:
X-O Manowar has beaten the Vine. Survived the Armor Hunters. Come face to face with the Armorines. Now he faces an unimaginable threat…a threat from beyond the grave.
The lesson needed to defeat them resides with his past and the greatest love of his life, Deidre of Dacia. But the last Aric knew of her, she was captured by the Roman legions and heading towards a slave camp. Her story, however, did not end there. Heavy hangs the head the that wears the crown.
Join New York Times best-selling writer Robert Venditti (Green Lantern, The Flash) and rising star Rafa Sandoval (X-Men: Legacy) for this special done-in-one jumping-on point issue – revisiting a mystery ripped from the pages of X-O Manowar #1!

mainsection.title: Part 3: Changing of the Guard
mainsection.plot:
Small package…heavy hitters! ENTER: ARMORINES smashes into a GIANT confrontation that will rock X-O Manowar to his very core!
The bleeding-edge commando unit codenamed: ARMORINES has finally undermined the X-O Manowar armor and the man inside it – Aric of Dacia, one of the most feared men alive. But who are these hardened men and women, and just who orchestrated their lethal combination of technology and cunning? The new generation of ARMORINES are more than just mercenaries…and the figure pulling their strings is about to activate a fail-safe that will leave the world reeling.

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot:
ARMORINES…ATTACK!
Aric of Dacia has laid waste to entire planets and defeated the universe’s most skilled hunters, but how can he kill what he can’t see? A strange new foe with a fiendishly familiar leader has unleashed a relentless offensive on Aric of Dacia, and he doesn’t even know it yet! Be here for the deadliest foe X-O Manowar has battled yet, as the ARMORINES continue their march towards Aric’s destruction!

mainsection.title: Part 3: Among The Living
mainsection.plot:
From across the void…the true history of the Armor Hunters revealed!
In the far reaches of deep space, an elite and hardened corps of soldiers has protected the galaxy by eliminating one unparalleled threat – a plague of X-O Manowar armors that has driven the universe to the brink of madness. Now, for the first time, Robert Venditti opens the vault to reveal the stunning secret of the Armor Hunters – who they are, where they come from, and why a terrible secret from their past now threatens the present!

mainsection.title: Part 4: Soft Targets
mainsection.plot: Toward the future, toward UNITY... With his nationstate of Dacia fortified in the eastern Hungary, X-O Manowar has bent the world to his will. But he will not stand unopposed. With the assembled forces of the United Nations and NATO primed to assail the newly founded homeland of the Visigoth people, the man inside the indestructible Manowar armor is about find himself more vulnerable than ever -- and with everything he holds dear on the threshold of a terrible turning point for the Valiant Universe...

mainsection.title: Part 3: Dacia
mainsection.plot:
To this king… a kingdom.
Since bonding with the sentient X-O Manowar armor, Aric of Dacia has rampaged unchecked, crushing every enemy in his path. But what happens when a one-man war machine must become the protector of an entire people? Aric’s skills as king are about to be put to the test, and the result will set off a chain reaction that will lead to one of the biggest confrontations in the history of the Valiant Universe!

mainsection.title: Part 4: To the Hilt
mainsection.plot:
Lock missiles and ZERO in on the can’t–miss origin of Aric of Dacia, a.k.a. X-O MANOWAR!
After narrowly surviving the events of ARMOR HUNTERS, X-O Manowar (or what’s left of him) must look to the future, but, to do so, Aric must first learn the startling secret of his past. Be here in October and learn the TRUE, violent origin of Visigoth life under the brutality of the Roman Empire.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: Cover by AARON LOPRESTI With the growing presence of super beings around the world, the United Nations resolves to create a new group called Justice League International. Batman, Booster Gold, Green Lantern Guy Gardner, August General in Iron, Fire, Ice, Vixen and Rocket Red are charged with promoting unity and trust - but can they reach that goal without killing each other first?

mainsection.title: Crisis on Infinite Earths- The Untold Story

series.displayname: Legends of the DC Universe: Crisis on Infinite Earths

mainsection.plot: A "missing chapter" to the classic Crisis on Infinite Earths reveals the final adventure of two of DC's most beloved characters: Silver Age Flash Barry Allen and the original Supergirl, Kara Zor-El. This extra-sized special takes place between Crisis on Infinite Earths (1985) #4 and #5, introducing the heroes of the never-before-glimpsed Earth-D! Flash, Supergirl and a host of characters from the late, great Earth-I team with Earth-D's counterparts to the Justice League in a desperate attempt to save as many lives...from as many Earths...as they can. Written by Marv Wolfman. Art by Paul Ryan and Bob McLeod. Painted cover by Glen Orbik. FC, 64 pg. Cover price $4.95.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st app. of Lasher, Phage, Agony & Riot

mainsection.title: A Verdict Of Violence
mainsection.plot: The families of Venom's victims unite, vowing to kill him. Spider-Man's hot on Venom's trail, too, while secrets are revealed about Eddie Brock's past. Written by David Michelinie. Art by Mark Bagley, Sam de la Rosa and Al Milgrom. Cover by Mark Bagley and Sam de la Rosa. Cover price $2.95

mainsection.title: Prologue: A Love To End All Time
mainsection.plot: Silver Foil Enhanced Cover by Jim Lee & Bob Layton; Chapter 1 "A Love to End All Time" by Bob Layton (script), Barry Windsor-Smith (art), & Jim Lee (inks); Solar, Man of the Atom, Void (WildC.A.T.S.) app; Chapter II "Universal Truth" by Bob Layton (script & inks) & Rob Liefeld (art); Bloodshot, Youngblood (Shaft, Die-Hard), Shadowman, WildC.A.T.S. (Zealot, Grifter, Voodoo), H.A.R.D. Corps, Magnus, Robot Fighter, Ripclaw, Spartan, Badrock, X-O Manowar, Prophet, Geoff the Geomancer, Berzerkers app; Cover price $2.95.

mainsection.title: Blue: Battlestone Vs. Magnus Robotfighter Outlaw! / Secret Forces / Sacrifices / Supremely Darque
mainsection.plot: Mike Leeke cover art. Story 1:"Battlestone vs. Magnus Robot Fighter" featuring characters from Magnus Robot Fighter and Brigade. Written by John Ostrander and drawn by Jim Calafiore. Story 2: "Secret Forces" featuring characters from Secret Weapons and CyberForce. Written by Joe St. Pierre and drawn by Sean Chen. Story 3: "Sacrifices" featuring characters from Harbinger, Brigade, & CyberForce. Written by Maurice Fontenot and drawn by Howard Simpson. mainsection.plot:
Remember the ’90s?!
The most elite assets of Project Rising Spirit team up for an early mission together — Bloodshot and the H.A.R.D. Corps, living weapons! But, in the decade of dial-up, the technology is far from perfect and bugs are bound to pop up in the wetware…with disastrous results…

mainsection.title: The Animus Engagement
mainsection.plot: Magus has the Infinity Guantlet, and the power he weilds is incredible. He cannot be defeated through force or power, but only by intellect. How will the heroes of reality outthink a god?

mainsection.title: Judgement
mainsection.plot: The Infinity Gauntlet has been wrested from the hand of Thanos, and all that he wrought with it has been undone. Now, the limitless power of the Infinity Gems lie in the hands of Adam Warlock, who was chiefly responsible for Thanos' defeat. But for how long?Eternity has brought his complaint before the Living Tribunal that Warlock should be stripped of the gems, as they are rightly aspects of his power... a claim that Adam protests vehemently. But as the case is presented, it is unclear as to whether even the Living Tribunal has the power to strip Adam Warlock of the Infinity Gauntlet.

mainsection.title: Part 18: Until The End Of Time
Part 3
mainsection.plot: A Renegade stands against The United! Even the addition of the bright and bubbly Faith Herbert - aka Zephyr of the Harbinger Renegades - can't solve Unity's PR crisis in the wake of the team's actions during the Armor Hunters' attack. But can she help stand against the threat of the international strike force known as THE UNITED? And what secret is the US harboring that threatens to push the world to the brink of war?

mainsection.title: Part 4: Cavalry
mainsection.plot: Last hope. Last stand. In the wake of Livewire's stunning sacrifice, how will X-O Manowar, Ninjak, and the Eternal Warrior comes to terms? With a punishing revenge mission led by Bloodshot, that's how! If it bleeds, they can kill itand the leaner, meaner Unity team just became a living, breathing box of armor-piercing rounds. The Armor Hunters put Earth in their bullseye Now, the bullseye bites back!

Still, even if Magog can steal the information he needs to take them down, he might have some explaining to do to the JSA and, worse - to his mother! On sale December 9 o 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

Written by Keith Giffen Art by Howard Porter & John Dell Cover by Glenn Fabry Sometimes powers are as much a curse as they are a blessing. But it could be out of the sewer and further into hell for the pseudo-god hero! On sale November 4 o 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

And that doesn't even compare to his more immediate problem: coming face-to-face with the putrid villain known as Miasma beneath New York City! Continuing the all-new series from writer Keith Giffen (JUSTICE LEAGUE INTERNATIONAL) and reuniting the best-selling JLA art team of penciller Howard Porter and inker John Dell! On sale October 7 o 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Lethal Force
mainsection.plot: Written by Keith Giffen Art and variant cover by Howard Porter & John Dell Cover by Glenn Fabry Introducing the latest member of the Justice Society of America to break out into his own monthly series! Tired of chafing at the restraints that being a member of the JSA put upon him, Magog decides to take justice into his own hands and track down who's behind the dealing of high-tech arms to lowlife scum around the DC Universe! Be here as the hunt starts Magog on the path to discovering his own unavoidable destiny thanks to writer Keith Giffen (JUSTICE LEAGUE INTERNATIONAL, DOOM PATROL) and artists Howard Porter and John Dell, the acclaimed team behind JLA! Retailers please note: This issue will ship with two covers. Tomasi Art by Fernando Pasarin Cover by Alex Ross Variant cover by Dale Eaglesham & Nathan Massengill He was Lance Corporal David Reid of the Justice Society of America until he was killed in action and resurrected by Gog as his herald - MAGOG. But who is David Reid? Does he truly believe in Gog? And to what lengths will he go in order to find justice in this world? Retailers please note: This issue will ship with two covers. For every 10 copies of the Standard Edition (with a cover by Alex Ross), retailers may order one copy of the Variant Edition (with a cover by Dale Eaglesham & Nathan Massengill). mainsection.plot: Written by Kevin J. Anderson Art by Barry Kitson & Gary Erskine Cover by John Watson The thrilling miniseries continues! Lord Dynamo and his robot-zombie henchmen continue to wreak havoc until he offers to save the human race, cure all diseases and end world hunger...but the price he demands may cost two JSA members everything! On sale Sept 15 ? 2 of 6 ? 40 pg, FC, $3.50 US Cover price $3.50.

mainsection.title: All in Color for a Dime!
mainsection.plot: Written by Kevin J. Anderson Art by Barry Kitson & Gary Erskine Cover by John Watson Lord Dynamo unleashes the awesome power of his gigantic zeppelin and an army of cyborg zombies! It's a battle of lightning blasts and powers that could level New York City! And a JSA member will not only lose his claim to power, but also his closest friend. On sale Nov 17 ? 4 of 6 ? 40 pg, FC, $3.50 US Cover price $3.50.

mainsection.title: Mercury Rising
mainsection.plot: Sabina Delacroix' interference in the Trials of Shazam is rapidly becoming a major threat. Having stolen part of the strength of Hercules, and all of Atlas' power she's now been given half of Apollo's power as well in an attempt to motivate Freddy to find someone to stand in Apollo's place holding up the world. Freddy is ahead of her in the trials, but only barely. And now the race is on to find Mercury... and Sabina is already a step ahead.

mainsection.title: He's Got the Whole World in his Hands
mainsection.plot: Freddy finds Atlas, the Greek god who maintains the world, murdered. When attempting to have Apollo take his place, Apollo challenges Freddy to a duel to the death.

mainsection.title: Nurture Vs. Nature
mainsection.plot: Hercules is imprisoned. A mystical battle, which the police mistook for a gang turf-war, leaves him stuck in jail. For all his power, he cannot leave. After Freddie refused to break him out to win his power, Sabina stole a measure of that power. Now, having been given the other half of the strength of Hercules, Freddie must survive Sabina's onslaught. But where Freddie's fighting skill had come from the magic that granted him power, Sabina has been well trained in the arts of combat. If Freddie can't defeat her, then she will be the sole heir to the power of SHAZAM.

mainsection.title: Hard Time
mainsection.plot: Captain Marvel Jr begins to come to terms with his new powers.Sabina is threatened by the Council of Merlin to improve her record against the Captain.Seeking out the next god, Hercules, Jr finds him in prison, accused of murdering several people. They may have been bystanders in a magical war, but because they are innocents, Hercules has to stay in jail. He tells Jr that the trial he faces is to get Hercules out of prison. Unfortunately, there is no way this can be done.Sabina, meanwhile, later appears to Hercules and asks him to grant her his powers and she will ignore the rules and break him out. He refuses and she steals his powers; as she comes face to face with Jr, Hercules grants him his powers and the pair face off.

mainsection.title: There's Magic In The Air
mainsection.plot: The race to possess the power of Shazam is running very closely. Freddy and Sabina are very nearly equal in power level, and both recruit their allies to try to find where the next god, Mercury, can be found. But it quickly becomes apparent that Sabina and her allies' ruthlessness is putting them ahead.

mainsection.title: Grounded
mainsection.plot: With a word, all of the power of the Marvel Family was snatched away, and surged into Billy Batson, formerly Captain Marvel. Mary Marvel lies in a coma at the hospital with severe burns covering her body. She was fighting a fire harpy when her powers vanished. Sitting by her bed, lightning strikes young Freddie Freeman as he says the name Shazam, and spirits him to the Rock of Eternity.Fate has chosen Freddie to succeed Billy as the acolyte of the power of Shazam as Billy now sits in the Wizard's place. But the rules of magic have been re-written since the Spectre ended the last age of Magic. The acolyte of Shazam will now have to maintain the delicate balance between our world, and the world of magic. And this is not a power that can be given. Freddie will be tested by each of the gods of magic that contribute to the power of Shazam.

mainsection.title: The boy & the Man
mainsection.plot: After the first year of the New Age of Magic, Captain Marvel has taken up residence in the Rock of Eternity as the guardian of magic. He has more control over his powers than ever before. But after stopping the blood sacrifice of a dozen children to summon a demon, when he says his magic word to return to being Billy Batson, a devestating lightning strike hits him. He doesn't change into Billy Batson, but is in fact transformed again... but into what or who?

mainsection.title: Part 4: "A" is for Courage... "M" is for Speed...

mainsection.plot: Written by JERRY ORDWAY Art by JERRY ORDWAY and DICK GIORDANO Cover by JERRY ORDWAY Lightning strikes four times in these tales from POWER OF SHAZAM #44-47! Captain Marvel battles Chain Lightning and Black Adam in these epics guest-starring Superman and The Justice League! On sale AUGUST 3 ? 96 pg, FC, $7.99 US

Written by JERRY ORDWAY Art by PETER KRAUSE and DICK GIORDANO Cover by JERRY ORDWAY The 4-part 'Monster Society of Evil' epic from THE POWER OF SHAZAM #38-41 is collected! Mr. Mind's out for vengeance - and he has help from Mister Atom, Sarge Steel, and more! On sale JULY 27 ? 96 pg, FC, $7.99 US

mainsection.title: Katana and Shazam!: Five Of A Kind, Part 2
Men and Boys! Gods and Thunder!

mainsection.plot: Written by ART BALTAZAR & FRANCO Art and cover by MIKE NORTON What happens when a few of Captain Marvel's old friends show up to hang out? When it's 'friends' like King Kull, Mr. ATOM, Dr. Sivana and Mr. Mind there's no predicting! But one thing is for sure: they're here not only to rock the city to its core, but also put the beat down on Captain Marvel! On sale SEPTEMBER 22 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

series.displayname: Billy Batson and the Magic of Shazam

mainsection.plot: Written by ART BALTAZAR & FRANCO Art and cover by MIKE NORTON Black Adam's got an amulet of power that just might let him destroy the Marvel family once and for all. And if it doesn't work, Black Adam Jr. will be happy to finish the job! If Freddy Freeman has already chosen the side of evil, do Billy and Mary have any chance of redeeming him?

series.displayname: Billy Batson and the Magic of Shazam

mainsection.plot: Written by ART BALTAZAR & FRANCO ? Art and cover by MIKE NORTON Three words: BLACK! ADAM! JUNIOR! Two more words: FREDDY! FREEMAN?!? That can't be right, can it? Billy and Mary are in real trouble now? From the Eisner-winning writers of TINY TITANS and the artist of BLUE BEETLE!

series.displayname: Billy Batson and the Magic of Shazam

mainsection.plot: On sale February 24 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.50 US Written by Art Baltazar & Franco ? Art by Mike Norton ? Cover by Byron Vaughns He's baaaaaaack! All the area kids are in for a day of fun at the museum when Billy and Mary run into none other than Theo Adam! Does he remember the magic word? No? but let's just say he'll be back in black before the day is done!

series.displayname: Billy Batson and the Magic of Shazam

mainsection.plot: Written by ART BALTAZAR & FRANCO Art and cover by MIKE NORTON Is the Wizard Shazam truly gone forever? Can Tawny regain his human form? And has Freddy Freeman found it in his heart to forgive Captain Marvel? These questions and more just might be answered in our rip-roaring final issue! Plus, a very surprising guest appearence. On sale AUGUST 25 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Between the Rock and a Hot Place
Rest in Peace
mainsection.plot: Written by Eric Wallace Art by Don Kramer & Michael Babinski Cover by Tom Feister BLACKEST NIGHT infects the Black Adam family when Osiris returns from the dead as a Black Lantern to terrorize young Billy and Mary Batson! Now powerless after the wizard Shazam deemed them unworthy in JUSTICE SOCIETY OF AMERICA #25, can the Batsons even count on the aid of Freddy Freeman, the new Captain Marvel? Find out in another of this month's one-issue revivals of classic DC Universe titles! ONE SHOT o on sale January 13 o 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Yeah-- This is a Face Only a Mother Could Love
Hard Like Satin
mainsection.plot: After catching Hussein Hussein, a small-time con man, the Spirit loses him to CIA agent Silk Satin... who loses him as soon as he gets out of the police station. But when the Octopus uses Hussein to lure both Satin and the Spirit together to Texas, can they dodge the him, stay alive in the Mexican desert, and avoid throttling each other?

mainsection.title: Media Man
mainsection.plot: While investigating another set of murders linked to Mortez, the man who 'killed' Denny Colt, the Spirit witnesses an advertisement for baked beans... with the Spirit as a mascot. An anime-style representation of the Spirit is being used by Carrion to sell baked beans dosed with extra sugar to children whose parents are too lazy to read the ingredients. But when the Cossack learns that two of his henchmen are assisting Carrion, and that the beans are former Soviet military rations, Carrion will need the Spirit's help to get out of his problems.

mainsection.title: Almost Blue
mainsection.plot: The Spirit's investigations into the apparent return of Elvarro Mortez lead him to Rico Velez, Mortez' stepbrother and the strange, sad tale of the musician called Almost Blue.

mainsection.title: Summer Special
mainsection.plot: DC presents three short tales of The Spirit. In Harder Than Diamonds, a cab driver is accused of having stolen a rich socialites diamonds but The Spirit thinks that the crime has wrapped itself up a bit too neatly. Determined to follow his nose, he makes his way past the spotlights and paparazzi to dig a little deeper, and maybe save an innocent man from some prison time. In Synchronicity, The Spirit pursues a petty thief through an old apartment building on a hot Summer day. But unknown to both the pursuer, and the pursued, the chase turns up one good outcome after another for the residents of the tenament. And in Hard Cell, The Spirit investigates a series of murders of domestic servants. The only link between them all is the movie actress for whom they all worked.

mainsection.title: Timebomb
mainsection.plot: The world is in danger. The Octopus has stolen a nuclear weapon, and has the Spirit as his hostage. Still hunting the Octopus, CIA Agent Silk Satin makes her way into the old water tower where the Octopus has hidden the bomb, and where he and the Spirit are fighting. But in the pitch black, the Octopus gets the drop on her. Shocking her with a tazer, the Octopus arms the bomb and leaves. Disarming weapons like this is one of the things that she's trained for, but the electricity has brought on a temporary state of amnesia. And the Spirit is way out of his depth with a nuclear weapon. Can he help Satin recover her memories in time to save the city?

mainsection.title: El Morte
mainsection.plot: The world is in danger. The Octopus has stolen a nuclear weapon, and has the Spirit as his hostage. Still hunting the Octopus, CIA Agent Silk Satin makes her way into the old water tower where the Octopus has hidden the bomb, and where he and the Spirit are fighting. But in the pitch black, the Octopus gets the drop on her. Shocking her with a tazer, the Octopus arms the bomb and leaves. Disarming weapons like this is one of the things that she's trained for, but the electricity has brought on a temporary state of amnesia. And the Spirit is way out of his depth with a nuclear weapon. Can he help Satin recover her memories in time to save the city?

mainsection.title: Death by Television
mainsection.plot: Someone is killing off all of the cable TV presenters.

mainsection.title: Day of the Dead
mainsection.plot: On the Day of the Dead, a final reckoning comes between the Spirit, and Alvarro Mortez, now known as El Morte. Mortez, the criminal that Denny Colt was trying to apprehend the night he died, has raised an army of the unquiet dead to raze Central City and destroy everything that The Spirit loves.But how can the Spirit stop an enemy who's already dead?

mainsection.title: Sand
mainsection.plot: Finding his old friend Hussein Hussein murdered, the Spirit readies himself to hunt down the killer. But his objectivity goes out the window when he learns the name of the criminal he was trying to catch... Sand Saref, his first love.

mainsection.title: The Diamond Exchange
mainsection.plot: Diamonds. P'Gell. The Miss World Supermodel competition. They couldn't all be linked...could they?

mainsection.title: Sea Cruise
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragones & Mark Evanier Art and cover by Paul Smith Ellen Dolan expects to get The Spirit alone on a luxury yacht?but an impossible mystery arises that distracts the Spirit's attention and puts all the passenger's lives in danger! On sale May 21? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Curse of the Mummies!
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragones & Mark Evanier Art by Paul Smith & Walden Wong Cover by Joe Kubert The Spirit must escort a shipment of mummies from Egypt to Central City . . . and then his troubles begin! On sale June 18 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: The Bully
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragones & Mark Evanier Art and cover by Paul Smith Once again the Spirit finds a way to cheat death in Central City in his trademark two-fisted-yet-lighthearted fashion! On sale July 23 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Fish Tale
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragones & Mark Evanier Art by Paul Smith & Walden Wong Cover by Paul Smith The Spirit swims with the dolphins - but murder follows him even among these peaceful creatures! On sale August 20 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: (Half) Way Out West
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragones & Mark Evanier Art by Aluir Amancio Cover by Joe Kubert Okay, no kidding. This time, for sure, The Spirit gets a break from the hustle and bustle of Central City's mean streets. Maybe fresh air out in the wide, open spaces is just what he needs? Right? On sale November 19 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Veteran's Benefits
mainsection.plot: Written by Sergio Aragon?s & Mark Evanier Art by Chad Hardin & Wayne Faucher Cover by Paul Smith The Spirit hits Cambodia! Somebody is murdering the former members of an Army platoon, one by one, and the trail leads back to Phnom Penh! A noir murder mystery in the Spirit style! On sale December 17 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Siren of the Opera
mainsection.plot: Written by Michael J. Uslan & F.J. DeSanto Art by Justiniano & Walden Wong Cover by Brian Bolland Turn your ears to the sweet song of Lorelei Rox at your own peril! 'The Siren of the Opera' introduces you to the most beautiful voice in Central City. But why does she sing for the evil Octopus? And what's her connection to the sultry Silken Floss? Whatever the answers, it sounds like trouble for The Spirit! On sale March 18 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: The Celtic Stone
mainsection.plot: Written by Mike Ploog Art by Mike Ploog & Dan Green Cover by Nick Cardy Commissioner Dolan's nephew Danny is in a whole heap of trouble, and it falls to The Spirit to rescue him - but to do so, he's got to contend with Danny's amnesia, a priceless stolen artifact, and the latest in The Spirit's run of femmes fatales, the deadly 'Adios!' Don't miss Eisner colleague Mike Ploog's return to THE SPIRIT in this two-part story! On sale July 22 o 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: The Celtic Stone
mainsection.plot: Written by Mike Ploog Art by Mike Ploog & Dan Green Cover by Gene Ha 'The Celtic Stone' concludes! The U.S. Army, the mystical Cormac and the beautiful Adios are all fighting to control the powerful Celtic Stone, and only one can walk away with it! Eisner colleague Mike Ploog wraps up his dizzying 2-parter - and the current volume of THE SPIRIT - with a bang? but stay tuned for a radical reinvention that will leave you breathless! FINAL ISSUE ? On sale August 5 ? 32 pg, FC, $2.99 US

mainsection.title: Sign of the Octopus / Black Alley / Sand Saref / Bring in Sand Saref
The Girl In The Bubble

series.displayname: Tom Strong and the Planet of Peril

mainsection.plot: At last, it's the return of Tom Strong-too bad he's powerless! The lives of his daughter Tesla and her unborn child both hang in the balance, and there's nothing Tom can do to save them...until he remembers the one thing that just might. To find it, he and Val Var Garm must journey to the far side of the galaxy, and the mysterious world known as... TERRA OBSCURA!

mainsection.title: Part 1; Connected
mainsection.plot: Written by DAVID HINE Co-feature written by MARV WOLFMAN Art by MORITAT Co-feature art by PHIL WINSLADE Cover by LADR?NN New series writer David Hine comes aboard for the first chapter of Frostbite! The ultimate high has arrived on the corners of Central City, and the ghouls who deal it aren't interested in cutting the all-controlling Octopus in on the action! It doesn't take long for hot blood to hit the icy city streets! And in the co-feature, THE SPIRIT: BLACK & WHITE, Marv Wolfman and Phil Winslade show us what happens in Central City when the lights go out - every last one of them! It's a citywide blackout in black and white! On sale JULY 21 40 pg, FC, $3.99 US

mainsection.title: Angel Smerti, Part 2
mainsection.plot: Written by MARK SCHULTZ Co-feature written by HARLAN ELLISON Art by MORITAT Co-feature art by KYLE BAKER Cover by LADR?NN In this second gripping issue, Angel Smerti is a lady who gets what she wants - and she wants The Spirit dead! The Spirit's first encounter with the Golden Tree crime organization will show him that the threat extends far beyond Central City! And in the co-feature, THE SPIRIT: BLACK & WHITE, modern fiction master Harlan Ellison teams with the brilliant Kyle Baker (WEDNESDAY COMICS) to bring an adventure right to the Spirit's backyard - Wildwood Cemetery!

mainsection.title: Part I
mainsection.plot: Written by MARK SCHULTZ ? Co-feature written by Dennis O'Neil ? Art by MORITAT Co-feature art by Bill Sienkiewicz ? Cover by LADR?NN ? 1:10 variant cover by MARK SCHULTZ The Spirit returns in an all-new ongoing series! Central City destroys everyone who lives within its borders... so it's a good thing The Spirit already died once! International crime syndicate The Golden Tree wants to help Central City's Octopus consolidate control over the underworld and the Spirit is the kind of mess the Golden Tree was created to clean up. They've offered the Octopus the services of one of their finest assassins to take his breath away for good - and the sight of this killer would get anyone's heart pounding! This issue also features the debut of the eight-page THE SPIRIT: BLACK & WHITE co-feature, showcasing the industry's finest talent. And who better to kick things off than DENNIS O'NEIL and BILL SIENKIEWICZ? Retailers please note: This issue will ship with two covers. Please see the Previews Order Form for more information.

mainsection.title: Conclusion
mainsection.plot: Written by BRIAN AZZARELLO Art by RAGS MORALES & RICK BRYANT Cover by J.G. JONES 1:10 Variant cover by JIM LEE This is it - the cataclysmic conclusion of the miniseries that launched the FIRST WAVE universe! Every life on Earth is threatened by Anton Colossi's mad ambition. But The Spirit is at death's door, The Batman is near his breaking point, and Doc Savage is at the mercy of a mad scientist! The stakes couldn't be higher - and in FIRST WAVE, anything can happen! Retailers please note: This issue will ship with two covers. Please see the Previews Order Form for more information. On sale JANUARY 26 * 6 of 6 * 40 pg, FC

mainsection.title: Book Five
mainsection.plot: Written by BRIAN AZZARELLO Art by RAGS MORALES & RICK BRYANT Cover by J.G. JONES 1:10 Variant cover by EDUARDO RISSO The Bat Man, Doc Savage and The Spirit are all on the scene in Hidalgo uncovering the secrets of Anton Colossi and his floating city. But Colossi still has a secret weapon that could put them all in their graves?along with nearly everyone else on Earth!

Written by BRIAN AZZARELLO Art by RAGS MORALES Cover by J.G. mainsection.title: Book One
mainsection.plot: Written by BRIAN AZZARELLO Art by RAGS MORALES Cover by J.G. JONES; 1:10 Variant cover by NEAL ADAMS DC's shocking new pulp universe is finally unveiled! In the shadows of the War, the roots of the Golden Tree cabal grew deep into the heart of a fallen world? and the leaders at the heart of this secret organization see no place in their utopia for heroism. Doc Savage, struggling with the loss of his father, has been blind to their advance - until now. Central City's mysterious Spirit has caught wind of their plans as well. But whose side have the Blackhawks chosen? What is the Red Right Hand? And where is the Batman? Eisner Award winner Brian Azzarello (100 BULLETS, JOKER) and superstar Rags Morales (IDENTITY CRISIS) craft a DC universe like you've never seen before! It's a world with no supermen, only mortal men? Death can come at any moment, and adventure can still be found at every corner of the map! Will Doc Savage be the first to lead the coming world or the last to be crushed under its heel? Retailers please note: This issue will ship with two covers. mainsection.title: A Strong and Loving World
mainsection.plot: Rorschach, Nite Owl, Ozymandias, Dr. Manhattan, and the Silk Spectre are reunited and faced with the new state of the world, and the new rules that go along with it. They must now choose between holding on to past ethics, or moving into the new state of affairs.

mainsection.title: The Human Torch! / The Angel / The Sub-Mariner / The Masked Raider / Jungle Terror / Burning Rubber / Adventures of Ka-Zar
mainsection.plot:
The Human Torch - Phineas T. Horton has done the impossible, and created an android. Unexpectedly, the android burns on contact with oxygen. Horton seals him underground to try and contain him until he can learn why, but the plan fails when a slow leak causes the Torch to explode free. Soon the Torch learns to control his flame, and learns that the world is filled with people who want to exploit him.


The Angel - Crime is running rampant, but the ruthless vigilante known as "The Angel" is on the job. He'll soon round up those behind the protection racket, but they won't necessarily make their way to prison.

The Sub-Mariner - An undersea exploration reveals a man who can swim in the depths without diving gear. This is Namor, prince of Atlantis, who has never seen a human before, and who assumes those in the diving gear are robots. He cuts their "control wires" and brings them home, only to learn he has started a war his people are looking forward to. He leads the first attack against the white man.

The Masked Raider - Brunder is running the town his way, and hustles Jim Gardley, who refuses to give in. Framed for a crime he didn't commit, Gardley escapes, and takes on the identity of the Masked Raider, a vigilante who dispenses harsh justice.

Jungle Terror - A man is worried about his uncle, so he and his uncle's partner head to the jungle to track him down. They crash, and are kidnapped by a local tribe. Upon escaping, they discover a fortune in diamonds.

Burning Rubber - prose - A race car driver has developed a new fuel pump. Though promising, it might in fact work too well.

Adventures of Ka-Zar - John Rand and his family crash their plane in the jungle. Young David loves it there, and soon befriends the local animals. His parents aren't as happy. His mother falls to a fever, and his father suffers partial amnesia. It isn't long before they discover looters, and John is killed. David is left without human company, though his lion friend Zar joins him, and names him brother Ka-Zar.

mainsection.title: Book Two: Verdicts
mainsection.plot: Continuing the all-new painted look at the modern Marvel Universe! Last issue we were introduced to Jeff Piper, an ordinary man trying to survive the mean streets of the Big Apple as an officer of the NYPD. In the second compelling chapter we jump ahead a few years and find Jeff knee deep in the good fight, all the while haunted by the temptation of the Kingpin and the danger posed by costumed gods like the Phoenix and the mighty Avengers. Chuck Dixon and Terese Neilsen take readers on a street-level tour of key events in the Marvel Universe from the '60s to today in this all-new, fully painted, bookshelf limited series.

mainsection.title: Book Four: Sirens
mainsection.plot: Concluding the fully-painted look at the modern Marvel Universe! Police Officer Jeff Piper figures he's seen it all in the super hero playground known as New York City - but h'es never seen anything like the phenom known as the Dark Phoenix! Writer Chuck Dixon takes readers on a street=level tour of key events in the Marvel Universe from the '60s to today in this all-new, fully-painted bookshelf limited series. In this final issue, Dixon teams with Code of Honor cover artist Brad Parker, who mixes computer enhanced photography with pain to create a unique art experience.

mainsection.title: Book Three: The Streets

mainsection.title: Part 8
mainsection.plot: The Wasp has been turned into a weapon of mass destruction, and it's up to Earth's heroes to prevent the cataclysm. Even when this is over and done with, there are ramifications that must be dealt with. The Skrulls attacked and hurt Earth like nobody ever has, and they did so on Tony Stark's watch. What happens to him and to S.H.I.E.L.D. is more severe than many would have predicted.

mainsection.title: Part 7
mainsection.plot: It's all out war as every able-bodied fighter on the planet joins the fracas on one side or another. Hero and villain alike unite on the side of Earth, with Nick Fury and Norman Osborn fighting side by side, Bullseye watching Spider-Man's back, Jessica Jones returning to combat, and other unusual alliances working together. The tide seems to be turning when the Skrulls unleash their secret weapon.

mainsection.title: Part 6
mainsection.plot: The Invasion is in full swing, and the Skrulls declare their intentions. However, Earth's heroes and a lot of its villains are not on board with the Skrull plan, and they pull themselves together to launch a major assault.

mainsection.title: Part 5
mainsection.plot:
The human resistance is starting to form. The Young Avengers awaken under the care of Nick Fury and his team. Norman Osborn and the Skrull Captain Marvel have a heart-to-heart that inspires the good captain to take immediate action. Maria Hill proves she's a better listener than anyone thought. Abigail Brand recruits considerable help of her own. The heroes in the Savage Land pull together and find transportation back to the main land.
And, until now, the Skrulls were having such a good day...

mainsection.title: Part 4
mainsection.plot: We are treated to an opening monologue detailing exactly how and why the Skrulls were able to execute their plan so easily and completely. Though they expect resistance, they also expect to win, for reasons Nick Fury clearly demonstrates. However, though they are doing well now, unexpected reinforcements are coming to Earth's aid.

mainsection.title: Part 3
mainsection.plot:
The Skrull Invasion is in high gear. The Jarvis Skrull is on the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier demanding a surrender, the Young Avengers are getting pounded by Super Skrulls, the Initiative recruits are deployed into combat unprepared by a disguised Yellowjacket, the Captain Marvel Skrull is attacking the Thunderbolts mountain, and the Avengers are falling victim to divide and conquer tactics led by the Skrull Queen, who talks to another character as though he's a sleeper agent. The Skrulls seem to have covered all possible sources of resistance.
They haven't, as the reader learns on the final page of the issue.

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: The old school heroes emerging from the Skrull spacecraft believe themselves to be the real deal. With each side assuming the other is composed of Skrulls, it doesn't take long for a battle to start. Ms. Marvel takes Iron Man away from the site to a local lab, where he starts "using his brain," a power the Skrulls can't copy, presumably to device some form of defense. Meanwhile, the Skrulls invading the rest of the world using their new super soldiers, and only the Young Avengers are around to stand in their way.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: The Skrull agenda that has been hinted at for months is put into top gear. A lone Skrull craft lands in the Savage Land, and both teams of Avengers head in to investigate, despite their lack of trust for each other. The find the installation they were captured in back from New Avengers #5, in much worse repair than it used to be. They also find the Skrull craft, but before they can tear it open, a wave of attacks from Skrull agents strike down most human resistance, often accompanied by the mantra "He Loves You." Iron Man is felled by a virus, the orbiting S.W.O.R.D. installation is destroyed, the Baxter Building is sucked into the Negative Zone, Reed Richards is seriously wounded, and a spacecraft full of what appear to be heroes in old school costumes cracks open.

mainsection.title: Part One
mainsection.plot: The Skrull Invasion is not limited to America, much to Britain's surprise and dismay. The Skrulls have mounted an organized attack directly against the portal to the otherworld Avalon, source of Britain's magic. Can even the combined forces of Captain Britain, Black Knight, Spitfire, Pete Wisdom and John the Skrull stand against them?

mainsection.title: Part One
mainsection.plot:
Demonic forces are at work in Birmingham. The mysterious entity known as Plokta is granting wishes to all, at the meager cost of their souls. And his power is growing, as more and more people rush to accept. Captain Britain is the first on the scene, and the temptation Plokta holds for him is immense.
Blade greeted Lady Jacqueline Falsworth with a stake to the heart. As a super-powered vampire, she's his worst nightmare, and he's worried that the use of her vampiric gifts in battle against the skrulls might have reawakened her bloodlust. He may be right.

mainsection.title: Part Two
mainsection.plot:
The mysterious being known as Plokta offers all within his power their heart's desire. All one has to do is look through one of the doors in the area under his control, and step through to claim it. The magical energy he's using from those who have accepted is building towards something.
Captain Britain was all too easily subdued by the desire to rescue his wife. The rest of the team is assaulted by temptation, but have thus far managed to hold it at bay. Captain Midlands has already refused, but the act has taken it's toll on him. But when Plokta manages to unleash the Mindless Ones, their lack of blood drives Dane's ebony blade mad with hunger. As he struggles with it, Pete makes a devestation revelation.

mainsection.title: Prologue
mainsection.plot:
On the moon, Dracula concludes the negotiations he requires to seize control of the British Isles. Agreeing to a non-aggression policy with Doom, and through him the other powers of the Cabal, Dracula has all that he needs to begin a full-scale invasion of the British Isles.
His first strike is aimed at felling MI:13. But in the event that any of them survive, he prepares to send a message to them.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: Dracula continues his plan to take the United Kingdom for vampires and monsters. Who is the traitor in the ranks of MI13? Can Spitfire possibly deny what she is? Can Captain Britain save his nation?
