mainsection.plot: Written by John Ney Rieber Art by Eric Nguyen Cover by Tim Bradstreet The new Sandman faces a terrible test. Jerusalem is burning and Kieran Marshall, the new Sandman, must search through the flames first for Devon, who has a bomb strapped to his chest, then for the kidnapped children Alia and Omar - all before the bomb explodes. ? 4 of 5 ? 32 pg, FC ? MATURE READERS Cover price $2.99.

mainsection.title: Sleep of Reason, Chapter Three

series.displayname: Sandman Mystery Theatre: Sleep of Reason

mainsection.plot: Written by John Ney Rieber Art by Eric Nguyen Cover by Tim Bradstreet Kieran Marshal struggles with his new role as the Sandman as he tracks the terrorist chieftain Masad to the holy city of Jerusalem. Now he must race to stop an apocalyptic terror plot that will bring his own nightmares to life. ? 3 of 5 ? 32 pg, FC ? MATURE READERS Cover price $2.99.

mainsection.title: Sleep of Reason, Chapter Two

series.displayname: Sandman Mystery Theatre: Sleep of Reason

mainsection.plot: Written by John Ney Rieber. Art by Eric Nguyen. Cover by Tim Bradstreet. Kieran finds himself in the care of refugees who have foreseen the coming of a man - or a monster - in a strange mask. They nurse him back to health, but his soul may be slipping into madness. His transformation into the Sandman can save him - or destroy him. ? 2 of 5 ? 32 pg, FC ? MATURE READERS Cover price $2.99.

mainsection.title: Sleep of Reason, Chapter One

series.displayname: Sandman Mystery Theatre: Sleep of Reason

mainsection.plot: Written by John Ney Rieber Art by Eric Nguyen Cover by Tim Bradstreet A Vertigo classic returns - with a vengeance! The fertile mind of writer John Ney Rieber (BOOKS OF MAGIC, Captain America) and the dynamic pen of artist Eric Nguyen (Strange Girl) have created a Sandman tale that both honors the classic character and will stand as a classic in its own right. A new age of terror demands a new Sandman to quell its nightmares. This disturbing new miniseries follows the final days of Wesley Dodds and his lifelong love Dian Belmont as they encounter a harrowing fate while traveling in Afghanistan circa 1997. Ten years later, with American troops on the ground in that country, wartime photojournalist Kieran Marshall is forced to take on the mantle of Wesley's former alter-ego, the terrifying crimefighter known as The Sandman. A dark and relevant tale that will appeal to new readers as well as fans of the classic Vertigo series, SLEEP OF REASON questions what it means to be human when confronted with evil. Marshall is a man in search of a career-making interview with master-terrorist Masad. When he confronts Masad face-to-face, he learns to his horror that this terrorist can teach him more about himself than he ever wanted to know. Becoming the new Sandman will be the only way Kieran can save his own life - but, possibly, at the cost of his humanity. Cover price $2.99.

mainsection.title: Chapter Two
mainsection.plot: The Sandman's epic origin story continues in the second issue of the new, bimonthly miniseries by the superstar team of writer Neil Gaiman and artist J.H. Williams III! As Morpheus transforms through the early ages, a mysterious white figure makes his own first appearance. And The Corinthian makes a deal - but it may prove to be a sacrifice that he's not able to live with.

mainsection.title: Chapter One
mainsection.plot: Twenty-five years since THE SANDMAN changed the landscape of modern comics, Neil Gaiman's legendary series is back! THE SANDMAN: OVERTURE heralds New York Times best-selling writer Neil Gaiman's return to the art form that made him famous, ably abetted by artistic luminary JH Williams III (BATWOMAN, PROMETHEA), whose lush, widescreen images provide an epic scope to The Sandman's origin story. From the birth of a galaxy to the moment that Morpheus is captured, THE SANDMAN: OVERTURE will feature cameo appearances by fan-favorite characters such as The Corinthian, Merv Pumpkinhead and, of course, the Dream King's siblings: Death, Desire, Despair, Delirium, Destruction and Destiny. 'People have often asked me what happened to Morpheus to make it possible for him to be captured in THE SANDMAN #1,' Gaiman said. 'And now they get to find out. And finding out, they get to learn secrets of the Endless that I've kept to myself for 25 years. Family secrets. And I should warn you: one of the Endless dies on page five.' The first issue of this 6-issue, bimonthly miniseries features a stunning double-page interior foldout.

mainsection.title: Part 4
mainsection.plot: A world on fire! Unity vs. The United! A dark secret at the heart of the Unity team has led the world to the brink of global war. Only Unity and their international counterparts, The United, can broker a peacebut that might not work, seeing as how they're trying to kill each other. All hope lies with Unity's newest team member, who may not be able to shoulder the weight of the world!

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: ALL-NEW ARC! WHO ARETHE UNITED? A new day has dawned for the elite assemblage of heroes called UNITY, and, in the wake of the Armor Hunters' invasion, the time has come to grow their ranks. Who will be the next fearless hero to join the roster of the world's most elite superteam? And just what is the international strike force called THE UNITED - and why have they marked UNITY's own X-O Manowar, Ninjak, Livewire, and Eternal Warrior for elimination? Red-hot creators Matt Kindt and CAFU detonate the planet's fi rst superteam vs. superteam war right here with a bold new beginning for UNITY!

mainsection.title: Part 2: History Lessons
mainsection.plot: Time to bring inBloodshot! The unrelenting force that is the Armor Hunters has wreaked havoc across planet Earth, cutting a swath of terror and destruction in their wake. Now the last, best chance at standing against the calculating wrath of the Hunters comes in the form of Unity: Livewire, Ninjak, The Eternal Warrior, and their newest recruitBLOODSHOT?! But can they stop the galactic warriors before they capture X-O Manowar and destroy Earth?!

mainsection.title: Part 1: Snapped!
mainsection.plot: ARMOR HUNTERS descends on Valiant's all-star superteam in an all-new story arc from New York Times best-selling writer Matt Kindt (Mind MGMT) and red-hot artist Stephen Segovia (Superior Carnage)! When an ultra-powerful threat from deep space begins brutalizing Earth, humanity's first response is - who else? - the fearless team of heroes, soldiers, and short fuses called Unity! Now it's down to Ninjak, Eternal Warrior and Livewire - plus some special surprise recruits - to lead the assault on the Armor Hunters' frontline...even if they die trying!

edition.displayname: Cvr B Chromium Cover Var Suayan | Reber

mainsection.title: Part 3: Ground Control
mainsection.plot: The final deathtrap of Dr. Silk! Ninjak's ultimate enemy has drawn his web tight around X-O Manowar and the rest of Valiant's unbreakable all-star superteamand now they're about to find out how the globe's most brilliantly depraved mind doles out revenge. 'Trapped by Webnet' cuts to an actionpacked conclusionand no one will escape Dr. Silk's grasp unscathed!

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: Drawn into the WEBNET! Unity is anything but unified as the team fractures and must start from scratch. But they'd better hurry because a new threat is loomingand Ninjak must tackle a viral epidemic that has been lying in wait for generations. A sickness is spreading across the land and only the doctor has the cure Dr. Silk!

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: ALL-NEW ARC! START READING HERE! For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. First came UNITY Now meet WEBNET! Coming off of the earth-shattering repercussions of their first mission, Ninjak is leading the newly formed Unity team right back into the trenches to face the Valiant Universe's next colossal threat - the enigmatic Dr. Silk and his high-tech terror cell: WEBNET! With the fate of untold millions on the line, can this team of cutthroat heroes uncover Silk's endgame - and his connection to Ninjak's shadowy past? Move over, Harada - Matt Kindt and Valiant's next superstar artist, CAFU (Action Comics), are about to bring the world's next A-level enemy down on Unity with the force of a hundred hydrogen bombs.

mainsection.title: Part 4: United We Fail
mainsection.plot: UNITY divided! Here comes heavyweight showdown you've been waiting for! As Harada's secret machinations come to light, the newly minted UNITY team will be faced with a choice that will change them forever - and the Valiant Universe along with it. Get ready for a world-shaking battle royale as the final installment of UNITY's first adventure pits X-O Manowar and Toyo Harada against the most dangerous battalion ever united - and each other.

mainsection.title: Part 3: Enter: Livewire!
mainsection.plot: Enter: Livewire! On an airtight team of stone-cold soldiers, Amanda McKee is the one variable in the equation that equals absolute kill. Now, as the last woman standing against the unstoppable force known as X-O Manowar, the Harbinger Foundation's most seasoned technopath has just added one new item to her resume -- newest bearer of the X-O Manowar armor and the finger behind the trigger of the universe's most powerful weapon. Watch out worldthis means trouble.

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: Broken but not beaten Unity has to put down X-O Manowar and avert nuclear war. But Harada's super-team lasted a grand total of five minutes last issue before they were taken out. Time for Unity 2.0, but how do you get a cast of malcontents, egotists, immortal warriors, and manipulative backstabbers to work together? The answer? You don't tell them they're working together.

mainsection.title: Part 1: Prisoners Of Circumstance
mainsection.plot:
To kill a king, he has created an army.
The world’s most dangerous man, Toyo Harada, has been struck by the one thing he never thought possible – fear. Halfway across the globe, a new power threatens to topple modern civilization and, to preempt the cataclysm that is to come, Harada will unite the most lethal, most volatile, most unforgiving team the world has ever known – UNITY. Their mission: defeat the warrior king armed with the universe’s most powerful weapon. Kill X-O Manowar!
Be here when New York Times best-selling writer Matt Kindt (Justice League of America, Mind MGMT) and superstar artist Doug Braithwaite (Justice, Journey into Mystery) launch Valiant’s first-ever superteam into the landmark comic book event of the year with an all-new ongoing series in UNITY #1, featuring covers by a murderer’s row of comics juggernauts – Doug Braithwaite, JG Jones, Bryan Hitch, Paolo Rivera, Clayton Crain, Travel Foreman, and Neal Adams!
You’ve heard the buzz, you’ve seen the reviews. If you still haven’t jumped onto Valiant Comics, the time is now! This November, UNITY is the perfect entry point for new readers.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot:
Before X-O Manowar… Before Ninjak… The world was changed in the trenches…
The unbreakable all-star superteam known as UNITY has saved the planet, and the world is in its debt…but is this the first time a band of exceptional heroes and soldiers has rescued humanity from a doomsday threat? The Eternal Warrior remembers, and, one hundred years ago, behind a curtain of barbed wire and corpses, he led another team of valiant champions on a life-or-death mission that changed the very course of history. Now, for the first time, find out why the world needs UNITY…and why there has always been one to stand against the threats no ordinary team could match!

mainsection.title: Part 3
mainsection.plot: In battle with the Armor Hunters! Mankind is locked in a life or death struggle against the alien Armor Hunters, and the fate of civilization itself now lies with the the unlikely team of short-tempered walking weapons called Unity! Can X-O Manowar give Ninjak, Livewire, and the Eternal Warrior enough of an edge to stop the galaxy's most feared team of hunter-killers before more die? There's no quarter asked and none given as Valiant's all-star superteam goes on the offensive!

mainsection.title: Here There Be Tigers
mainsection.plot: Covers: Alex Ross Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Steve Scott Following the disaster of Ilili, Captain Victory and his crew race back to Ranger Center to confront the traitor in their midst! But the traitor's got a secret weapon of his own aboard the Dreadnaught Tiger, a sleeper agent activated if Victory ever discovered what was really happening within the Galactic Command. Victory is forced to fight one of his own as Tiger 20 attacks!

What are the secrets of the Dreadnaught Eagle? Captain Victory and his men are beset on all sides by their enemies, and only the Dreadnaught Eagle's black box holds the key to their escape! Can Mister Mind -- the hyper intelligent helmsman of Victory's crew -- crack the black box's quantum-locked encryptions in time? Or will the terrifying and dark secrets of the black box drive Mister Mind mad?

mainsection.title: Sounds
mainsection.plot: Covers: Alex Ross, Michael Avon Oeming (1-in-10) Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Wagner Reis When Captain Victory brings a mysterious wounded woman on board the Dreadnaught Tiger, it's up to the mysterious amphibious Orca to discover just what happened to her! As he trawls through black waters of the planet Dok searching for clues, however, Orca's memories begin to surface. Will his past catch up to him just in time to drag him down? Or will Victory lose another crew member in a tragic accident?

mainsection.title: Galactic Commands!
mainsection.plot: Covers: Alex Ross Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Wagner Reis Captain Victory and the crew of the Dreadnaught Tiger return to the Galactic Rangers headquarters to face up to the charges that have been brought against them. The governing body of the Galactic Rangers punish Victory, sending him on a fool's errand to save a damaged Dreadnaught in the middle of a galactic graveyard! But the mysteries they find awaiting them there could change the Galactic Rangers' very existence...

mainsection.title: Tarin's Tale
mainsection.plot: Covers: Alex Ross, Michael Avon Oeming (1-in-10) Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Wagner Reis Jack Kirby's epic space opera continues! Last issue, Captain Victory was forced to make a terrible choice in order to stop the malicious Batteron. Now that decision comes back to haunt him as several members of his crew plot mutiny. As tempers flare, however, the ship is attacked by the Eye of Blackmass, punching a hole in the ship's hull that threatens to kill everyone aboard! Is it still mutiny if Captain Victory is dead? Plus, the secret origin of everyone's favorite lion-man, Tarin!

mainsection.title: Victory Is Sacrifice
mainsection.plot: Covers: Sean Chen Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Wagner Reis The enigmatic soldier known as Captain Victory leads an elite group of intergalactic rangers through the mysterious and deadly cosmos, fighting against forces set on the destruction of life, itself! But who is this man, and what does he want? This special introductory issue written by Sterling Gates and drawn by Wagner Reis starts with a bang, as the deadliest battle Captain Victory and his men have ever fought begins!

mainsection.title: Victory Is Sacrifice
mainsection.plot: Covers: Michael Avon Oeming Writer: Sterling Gates Artist: Wagner Reis The enigmatic soldier known as Captain Victory leads an elite group of intergalactic rangers through the mysterious and deadly cosmos, fighting against forces set on the destruction of life, itself! But who is this man, and what does he want? This special introductory issue written by Sterling Gates and drawn by Wagner Reis starts with a bang, as the deadliest battle Captain Victory and his men have ever fought begins!

mainsection.title: Hungry For Heroes...or A Sandwich to Die For
Atomics Lies
mainsection.plot:
Prime has defied Colonel Samuels, and rescued Mantra from Dr. Gross.. but the Colonel doesn't tolerate defiance. Shackling Kevin with a collar designed to use electric shocks to prevent him from becoming Prime, Samuels plans to control Kevin's transformations going forward.
He sends Kevin to clear civillian protestors out from a former nuclear test site... one where Samuels has stashed several live warheads, one of which has been triggered by their presence, counting down to a detonation. But when Kevin learns that Samuels has been deceiving him this whole time, Prime sets the Colonel in his sights.

mainsection.title: The Return of Doctor Gross
mainsection.plot:
Returning from the moon, Primes body is beginning to break down. Desperate, he uses the sash given to him on the moon to call upon Mantra for aid, and she guides him to impact in the swimming pool of Mantra's secret identity, Eden Blake.
But when news of Prime's return from the moon hits, both Colonel Samuels and his father begin searching the area for him. But they aren't the only ones... Dr. Gross, the man responsible for Prime's creation also wants to recover him.

mainsection.title: Villains
mainsection.plot:
Kevin, and his would-be girlfriend Kelly find themselves confronted by a demon in the form of Maxi-Man, the hero from a child's cartoon. Desperate to save Kelly, Kevin transforms once again into Prime, despite the short time-frame since he last transformed. To save her, he takes on the image of his childhood hero.
His father has contacted Colonel Samuels. The two clearly know something about the nature of Prime's existence, and Samuels is the only chance Russell has of giving his son a normal life.

mainsection.title: Dead Again... And Again
mainsection.plot:
Prime finds himself choking. Before he passes out, the strange events of the past days pass before his eyes. He awakens secured to a chair, as a strange scientist explains how Prime (and others) were created as part of a secret government program carried out through a fertility clinic.
Enraged by this explanation, Kevin bursts free from his captivity and escapes. Determined to find help, he goes to track down the only Ultra he thinks he might be able to find... Hardcase.

mainsection.title: Party Time
mainsection.plot: Party Time - Written by Steve Englehart. Art by Rick Hoberg & Tim Eldred. Cover by Rick Hoberg & Al Vey. The Strangers think they have a lazy day ahead of them, full of sun, sports and fun...that is, until a bunch of Ultras crash the party! And that isn't the only thing wrong -- Candy again feels the cold hand of doom from Teknight. Could death be on the horizon? 32 pages, full color. Cover price $1.95.

mainsection.title: You Can Take The Cop Out Of The Sewer
Something Wicked Comes This Way
mainsection.plot: Stephen Mooney (w & a & c) As the team prepare for an all-out assault on the Nazi base, friendships are formed and secrets revealed. It's four operatives against an entire company of S.S., led by the formidable Oberleutnant Toht. And then of course there are the scores of unleashed dinosaurswhat could possibly go wrong?
For subscription customers only enlist up at your local comic shop! A variant cover by Tommy Lee Edwards! Only for loyal subscription box customers!

series.displayname: Treasure Chest of Fun and Fact, Vol. 22

mainsection.plot: The Human Rocket returns! You've followed him through the history making (and changing!) AvX and now the mystery of the all-new Nova are revealed in this breathtaking new ongoing by the best-selling, award winning team of Jeph Loeb and Ed McGuinness (RED HULK, Avengers X-Sanction). Sam Alexander is a kid bound by the gravity of a small town and a father whose ridiculous, drunken fairy tales about a 'Nova Corps' were just another heavy burden in a life full of them. But luckily for Sam Alexandersoon gravity won't even matter. And those troubles? It's like they're a billion miles away.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st solo title feat. Nova, Sam Alexander

mainsection.plot: The Human Rocket returns! You've followed him through the history making (and changing!) AvX and now the mystery of the all-new Nova are revealed in this breathtaking new ongoing by the best-selling, award winning team of Jeph Loeb and Ed McGuinness (RED HULK, Avengers X-Sanction). Sam Alexander is a kid bound by the gravity of a small town and a father whose ridiculous, drunken fairy tales about a 'Nova Corps' were just another heavy burden in a life full of them. But luckily for Sam Alexandersoon gravity won't even matter. And those troubles? It's like they're a billion miles away.

mainsection.plot: The Human Rocket returns! You've followed him through the history making (and changing!) AvX and now the mystery of the all-new Nova are revealed in this breathtaking new ongoing by the best-selling, award winning team of Jeph Loeb and Ed McGuinness (RED HULK, Avengers X-Sanction). Sam Alexander is a kid bound by the gravity of a small town and a father whose ridiculous, drunken fairy tales about a 'Nova Corps' were just another heavy burden in a life full of them. But luckily for Sam Alexander?soon gravity won't even matter. And those troubles? It's like they're a billion miles away.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st solo title feat. Nova, Sam Alexander

mainsection.title: Chapter Two: Believe
mainsection.plot: A boy, a helmet, and an intergalactic legacy! - Sam Alexander isn't just any 15-year old, he's just been recruited to the Nova Corps: the Universe's police force. - What do you get when you pair a raccoon, a green alien lady and a scared teenager? An amazingly awesome origin tale!

mainsection.title: Chapter Three: Train
mainsection.plot: - It's time for Sam Alexander's Training Day. And with the Guardians of Galaxy' s Gamora and Rocket Raccoon in charge, Nova soon learns that old lesson 'Practice Makes Painful!'

mainsection.title: Chapter Four: Betrayal
mainsection.plot: The comic everyone is talking about continues! - The mysteries surrounding the disappearance of Sam's dad deepen and the helmet leads Nova into intergalactic conflict that will affect the entire Marvel Universe!

mainsection.title: Chapter Five: Victory
mainsection.plot: - The origin of the most talked about new character of the year comes to a shattering conclusion. - Jeph Loeb and Ed McGuinness, two of the most popular creators in comics, bring you an Infinite-ly dramatic turning point in the life of Nova as he discovers that something out in the galaxy is threatening everything he knows.

mainsection.title: Chapter Six: Home Field
mainsection.plot: Now that we've seen his origin, there's only one thing standing between Nova and being an Avenger--He needs to ask his mom.

mainsection.title: Chapter Seven: Away Game
mainsection.plot: Nova's Eventful World-Wide Adventure Rockets Roaringly Into Our Renegade Spider! Zeb Wells ('Robot Chicken', dressing as Thor on the internet) and Paco Medina (Ultimate X-Men) continue the story of Marvel's newest, least experienced hero: Sam Alexander. We'll get to tying into Infinity next month, but you should probably pick this one up first.

mainsection.title: Chapter Ten: Land and Launch
mainsection.plot: 100TH ISSUE ANNIVERSARY SPECIAL! - Big changes for Sam Alexander in this supersonic supersized 100th issue! - Guest staring the new New Warriors! - And as if that's not enough new, you also get a whole bonus story from new regular Nova writer Gerry Duggan!

mainsection.title: Chapter XI: Pawn Takes Night
mainsection.plot: - It's All-New Nova Now as we welcome new writer Gerry Duggan (DEADPOOL; 'Guy' on one episode of the SARAH SILVERMAN PROGRAM)! - The deadly secrets of the Nova Corps stand revealed...and Sam is waaay over his helmeted head. - This is the beginning of something big, cosmic fans! An EPIC Odyssey that will take our warp speed wunderkind to the very ends of the Marvel Universe!

mainsection.title: Chapter XII: Help Wanted
mainsection.plot: - Hot on the trail of the missing Nova Corps, Nova and manages to save the lives of some new friends in deep space.

mainsection.title: Chapter XIV: Road to Knowhere
mainsection.plot: IT'S A BAD TIME TO BE A NOVA! David Baldeon (Scarlet Spider) joins Gerry Duggan for an interstellar adventure with Beta Ray Bill begins with a bang (and a massive robotic battle)! It's clean-up time as Sam and Bill ride through the cosmos attempting to right the wrongs that Sam caused!

mainsection.title: Chapter XV: Can We Keep Him?
mainsection.plot: - Sam leads an intergalactic exodus off an orbiting slum. - Can he rescue Beta Ray Bill's people before they're sold into slavery, and will he catch up to Captain Skaarn before he can hurt anyone else?

mainsection.title: Chapter XVI: Battle Skaarns
mainsection.plot: - Sam's adventure with Beta Ray Bill in space comes to a shocking conclusion and Sam arrives home to a very unpleasant discovery. (No, it's not the Statue of Liberty on its side.)

mainsection.title: Chapter XVII: Home Alone
mainsection.plot: - Sam is back from outer-space and discovers his greatest threat right on his doorstep! - When the Alexander home is threatened, this time there may not be anything that Nova can do to help out.

mainsection.title: Chapter XXI: Moving Day
mainsection.plot: - Spinning right out of the events of ORIGINAL SIN, Sam has new information about his dad-- both newly revealed and troubling secrets and his whereabouts! - It's up to Sam to find his former-Nova father halfway across the universe and either give him salvation or justice!

mainsection.title: Chapter XXII: Children of the Candy Corn
mainsection.plot: - It's Halloween and Nova goes to Westchester to join the students of the Jean Grey School for trick-or-treating! - With Beast chaperoning, what sort of trouble can the kids get into? LOTS! Rated T

mainsection.title: Chapter XXIII: Wouldn't Mama Be Proud
mainsection.plot: AXIS TIE-IN! - Nova faces is that the Hulk? - Find out why they're fighting and just how Sam thinks he has a chance! Rated T

mainsection.title: Chapter XXIV: Stupidity Tries
mainsection.plot: AXIS TIE-IN! - Nova faces is that the Hulk? - Find out why they're fighting and just how Sam thinks he has a chance! Rated T

mainsection.title: Chapter XXV: The Super-Saver Club Card
mainsection.plot: AXIS TIE-IN! - Over-sized monumental 25th issue and great jumping-on point! - Things are changing for Sam Alexander, A.K.A. Nova, the Human Rocket, so get on board to the fastest moving comic in the business! Rated T+

mainsection.title: Part 2
mainsection.plot: - Hot out of the Black Vortex Crossover, Nova is back on Earth! - But problems have followed him back to Earth and this arc will test Sam more than anything ever has before. Rated T

mainsection.title: Most Wanted
mainsection.plot: Richard refuses to believe for a second that Chris Powell would have killed Lilandra, and wants to make sure he's the first to find his friend. When he does, both are in for a surprise, as they world they are on starts to collapse, and Kree scientists becomes a Raptor.

mainsection.title: Nova Against the Mighty Thor
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider is having a hard time doing the superhero thing and keeping up with his schoolwork, but that doesn't stop him from trying to meet Thor when the opportunity presents itself. Thor isn't himself, though; little does Rich know, but Thor is under the control of the Corrupter, and he attacks Nova on sight. Can Nova's alien strength hold off a genuine god?

mainsection.title: World War 1 Continues: Invasion Of The Body Changers
mainsection.plot: Nova and the others are continuing the journey begun in an earlier issue. There is much uneasiness in the crew, as they do not get along very well. They are suddenly attacked by the Skrull Armada that launched in Fantastic Four 205, and though they manage to win the battle, Powerhouse and other allies are very weakened by the effort.

mainsection.title: Chapter XVIII: Dia De Los Muertos
mainsection.plot: EVERYBODY HAS ONE...

mainsection.title: Chapter XIX: Original Sin Part II
mainsection.plot: ORIGINAL SIN tie-in! - Original Sin presents a pair of mysteries: - Was Nova's father a murderer? What is the secret origin of the Black Novas? - As Sam grieves for The Watcher, he turns to a friend for help -- Rocket Raccoon!

mainsection.title: Chapter Eight: Infinity
mainsection.plot: Infinity tie-in! - Nova's first taste of the power of a mad cosmic god threatens to--blah blah blah... Look, NovaNauts, this one's huge! Get it before we make a movie out of it!

mainsection.title: Chapter Nine: Infinity2
mainsection.plot: INFINITY TIE-IN! - The events of INFINITY have Sam Alexander in over his head, but he's about to get back up from some Nice Entertaining Wallflowers Who--okay, this is exhausting. They're a couple of dudes from the New Warriors. - Will Nova help them put their team back together?

mainsection.title: Chapter XIII: The Punch-Out at the Carefree Corral
mainsection.plot: All-New Marvel Now means some All-New Nova Wow! After Infinity, Inhumanity, and the landmark 100th appearance of Nova, it's been a crazy year for the galaxy's newest hero! As Sam Alexander continues to hunt down clues of the Nova Corps demise, he finds an all new threat of his own making. But the arrival of former Mjolnir-wielder Beta Ray Bill means Nova's days may be numbered.

mainsection.title: Part One: The Gathering
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider and Chris Powell have been whisked away from the dying world of Shard to places unknown but clearly inspired by Egypt. There they meet the Sphinx, who has plans for them, as well as Reed Richards, but he's a version from an earlier time. They also meet a version of Black Bolt, who brings with him someone else believed dead.

mainsection.title: Part Two: The Book of the Dead
mainsection.plot: The warriors chosen by the Sphinx are facing a new threat. There is a second Sphinx, brought from his own past, and the two are fighting for control. The younger one wants to possess two Ka stones, thus becoming a being of unimaginable power, and reshaping the universe in his own image.

mainsection.title: Part Three
mainsection.plot: The two Sphinxes have summoned their champions to their sides. The teams are forced to fight in single combat, with hopes of saving their worlds. However, it is not long before the presence of Darkhawk is revealed and the balance tips.

mainsection.title: Time Out
mainsection.plot: The Sphinx has two Ka stones, and he's rewriting reality to accept that possibility. That gives the chosen heroes of both Sphinxes a small window of opportunity to set things right. If only they knew how...

Nova is back, and he and Darkhawk are checking out Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. Word of the Cancerverse has come from Quasar, but there's another Quasar at the project, and the Nova Corps decides to assess and end the threat.
Richard is having a hard time dealing with the sudden return of the Nova Corps, but that isn't nearly as surprising as some of the members the Worldmind has selected to join it.

mainsection.title: Saving Private Robbie
mainsection.plot: Nova has rebooted the Worldmind, and is assessing the state of affairs once more. He begins a plan to recover lost Centurians, and soon learns that his brother is among the missing. The search takes him to a world decorated in Nova helmets, which is not a promising sight.

mainsection.title: Heavy Mettle
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider is contemplative, unsure about whether or not he has what it takes to be a Nova Centurian as well as a New Warrior. His introspection is cut short by an attack from unknown agents, and the repeated attacks endanger some of his closest civilian friends. Can he prove he has what it takes, if only to himself?

mainsection.title: Heavy Mettle
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider is contemplative, unsure about whether or not he has what it takes to be a Nova Centurian as well as a New Warrior. His introspection is cut short by an attack from unknown agents, and the repeated attacks endanger some of his closest civilian friends. Can he prove he has what it takes, if only to himself?

mainsection.title: Starting Over
mainsection.plot: Rich has his powers back, and he's trying to get his life together again. That always goes well for young super heroes.

mainsection.title: Brave New World
mainsection.plot: Nova races into orbit to face the threat of Ego, only to find that Ego is the new home for the Xandarian Worldmind and the rebuilt Nova Corps. Richard is finding it hard to deal with, and has to ask himself some tough questions. Why didn't the Worldmind trust him with this information? Is it really this much of a problem? Is he actually cracking under the pressure he's dealt with? What's the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow? (Okay, he's not really worried about that last one.)

mainsection.title: Part 3
mainsection.plot: CONCLUSION TO THE UNCANNY X-MEN/IRON MAN/NOVA CROSSOVER - 'NO END IN SIGHT' - Nova gets tied up into an adventure with the Uncanny X-Men and Iron Man that takes him half-way across the galaxy. - See three of the best books at Marvel collid

Richard Rider, having escaped the Vore in "Nova, Vol. 4 #10," awakens 43 years in the future. The Transmode virus resurges once more, right when the rebuilt Nova Corps is about to mount a final assault to free Earth. Due to his illness, Nova is unable to join the battle.

mainsection.title: Krushed
mainsection.plot: Nova and the other Centurians have their hands full. Mindless Ones are attacking Philo's ship, the prisoner has escaped, Starstalker is looking for a bounty, and Ego is not even remotely happy about having been turned into Nu-Xandar. To top it all off, there are others in the vicinity they'll need to deal with if they get through this mess.

mainsection.title: Part 1
mainsection.plot: The Nova Corps has picked up a distress call and are responding accordingly. They find a ship absent through the fault for 35 years has now returned, and its captain is a Nova Centurion escorting a prisoner. Unfortunately, the Corps are not the only ones interested in him.

mainsection.title: War Crimes
mainsection.plot: Richard, and the Centurions he brought with him have found his brother Robbie, but he's been brutalized by Xenith - the new Strontian in the Shi'ar Praetorian Guard. They manage to apprehend her, rescue Robbie and provide asylum for Ravenous with some convincing of 'King' Blastaar to respect the Nova Corps. Deciding that the Worldmind was right in believing that there must be a Nova Corps again, Richard resolves to begin rebuilding... but at a slower pace. And the Centurions who proved themselves amidst the chaos of the War of Kings are taken on as his first recruits. They set a course for Shi'ar space to witness the devastation wrought by the Inhumans T-Bomb.

mainsection.title: Shock and Awe
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider leads a small group of troops to rescue his brother. They encounter Blastaar along the way, and are granted passage to find Robbie, who has his hands full with Strontian.

mainsection.title: Saving Private Robbie
mainsection.plot: Nova has rebooted the Worldmind, and is assessing the state of affairs once more. He begins a plan to recover lost Centurians, and soon learns that his brother is among the missing. The search takes him to a world decorated in Nova helmets, which is not a promising sight.

mainsection.title: Empire of the Mind
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider realizes why the Worldmind has been so different lately; he's been fused with Ego, and is no longer in control of the Nova Corps. Richard does the only thing he can do to repair things: he fights Worldmind and the entire Corps with the intent to gain back the Nova Prime power and save the Worldmind from itself.

Richard Rider is still adjusting to his new powers with the help of Wendell Vaughn. His first step is Nu-Xandar, where the Worldmind gives him quite the surprise. Meanwhile, the Nova Corps are working to block Shi'Ar expansion, but the untrained soldiers in the field are not ready to face off against the Shi'Ar Imperial Guard.

mainsection.title: End of Story
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider has less than 48 hours to live. He's going to find that hard to cope with if he doesn't get some sort of psychological or medical help. Quasar offers, but vanishes. He heads back to P.E.G.A.S.U.S. to get their help, only to find H.A.M.M.E.R. has secured the location, and Dr. Eve Neckar has been collecting two paychecks. Just when things couldn't get any weirder, Quasar returns.

mainsection.title: The Rapture
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider heads back to Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S. to determine how sane he really is. He soon learns about his own level of health, as well as that of the other Nova Corps members. These discoveries are not popular with the Worldmind.

mainsection.title: Corps Values
mainsection.plot: The Nova Corps is being reformed, whether Richard likes it or not. The Worldmind has selected several strong candidates from other worlds, but needs more to continue its plans. Richard continues to lead the new ones in battle against Earth's supervillains in the wake of the Secret Invasion.
Richard is having a hard time dealing with the sudden return of the Nova Corps, but that isn't nearly as surprising as some of the members the Worldmind has selected to join it.

mainsection.title: Reborn
mainsection.plot: Nova continues the fight against the Skrull invaders at Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S., and turns the tide of battle when he picks up a few unexpected allies. Just as things are looking up, he finds yet more allies that he hadn't anticipated, and may or may not be happy to see.

mainsection.title: Brothers In Arms
mainsection.plot: Nova returns to Earth. First, he has to deal with betrayal from the Super-Skrull, and then do what he can to save his family from a Skrull invasion. It's not easy, but with the help of Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S., he just might pull it off.

mainsection.title: Green For Danger
mainsection.plot: Nova is targeted by an assassination attempt, aimed at preventing him from coming to the Earth's defense during the Secret Invasion. He is aided by Kl'rt, former ally and fallen Skrull, who offers to go with him in aid of the Earth. When they arrive, they find that things do not go as planned.

mainsection.title: What's Next
mainsection.plot: Thanks to the Annihilation wave, Richard Rider is the only member of the Nova Corps left. He takes that responsibility seriously, and is working hard to respond to as many distress calls as possible. The Xandarian Worldmind is concerned that he isn't taking enough down time. When Richard's fatigue almost takes them both out, the Worldmind suggests a brief visit to Earth.

mainsection.title: Alienation
mainsection.plot: Richard Rider has returned home for the first time since the incident in Stamford that kicked off the Civil War. He's having a hard time wrapping his head around the changes that have occurred since he was last here, including the deaths of his fellow New Warriors. He tries to stay low key, but when he's attacked by Diamondhead, that doesn't play out as he'd hoped.

mainsection.title: Home Truths
mainsection.plot: The Thunderbolts are treating Richard as an unregistered superhero, and come to take him in. He's not about to go in quietly, particularly since the 24 hours Tony Stark gave him aren't up yet. After he has a private conversation with Robbie Baldwin, he decides to take some private time for himself.

mainsection.title: Part One
mainsection.plot: Richard finds himself stranded in the middle of Knowhere, the head of a decapitated Celestial that is adrift at the end of all that is known. While trying to take this fact in, he encounters the zombified heroes of another world, and he's far from his top fighting condition.

comic.keycomicreason: 1st app. of Cosmo, 1st app. of Knowhere

mainsection.title: Part Two
mainsection.plot: Nova has contained Abyss, and managed to restore Knowhere, but it is at the cost of his control of the Phalanx technovirus. Cosmo directs him to the Phalanx homeworld of Kvch, but unfortunately, he is not the only one to travel there.

mainsection.title: Vore
mainsection.plot: Nova, Gamora and Drax are captured by a Vore, which feeds on interspace life and has stored them as food for its young. After an unlikely team-up, they escape, but now the Transmode virus is severely encroaching on Richard's body.

mainsection.title: Terminal
mainsection.plot: Nova has arrived on Kvch, following the events of "Nova, Vol. 4 Annual #1." Here he meets Warlock, formerly of the New Mutants, and they catch up on each other's recent histories. Warlock is unable to cure the Transmode virus as Nova had hoped, but that won't make a difference now that Gamora and Drax have arrived.

mainsection.title: The Devourer
mainsection.plot: Nova finds a way offworld, though it's not an easy path. In fact, the Worldmind shuts down, leaving him with very limited resources to deal with Harrow, who also found a way offworld. Nova faces Harrow, but without the Worldmind's aid, he cannot keep his own mind clear of Harrow's telepathic attack. He is just starting to realize what kind of creature Harrow really is when the Silver Surfer arrives and intervenes.

mainsection.title: In the Final Hour
mainsection.plot: Nova convinces the Silver Surfer to offer the world a stay of execution, allowing the residents to escape unharmed. Unfortunately, Harrow has also escaped, and dealing with him costs Nova precious time.

mainsection.title: On The Last Day
mainsection.plot: Nova has arrived at a world that has been selected by Galactus. Arriving too late to stop the feeding, he works to evacuate the population, only to be slowed by the presence of a psychic and psychotic entity that is feeding off the population.

mainsection.title: Inheritance
mainsection.plot: Nova agrees to stand against the Siredam to buy Tyro enough time to escape, so Warlock sacrifices his lifeglow to save Nova from the Transmode virus. Nova tries to keep up his end of the bargain, but Tyro disobeys orders and returns, making it difficult for Nova to lead him away.

(Okay it's actually the 101st, but we had an X-Men crossover to get through! Sheesh!) - It's an all-star celebration of the most popular super team of 2014 as cosmic captain Brian Michael Bendis welcomes Nick Bradshaw (WOLVERINE AND THE X-MEN) to the team! - As the GOTG gets ready for new members VENOM and CAPTAIN MARVEL, there are unexpected dangers that promise to tear the team to its core. - Plus in this special double sized anniversary issue...two special back up stories by former GOTG writers Dan Abnett and Andy Lanning!

(It's not a band, it's an ancient cosmic artifact that is gonna cause big trouble.) - Dude, space is awesome, but the ice cream up here suuuuucks. Rated T

mainsection.title: Part 2

When an alien race discovers that the original Jean Grey is back on Earth, they decide to hold her accountable for the acts of the Dark Phoenix, and it's up to the Guardians to help the X-Men save her. You won't want to miss the first encounter between two of the biggest franchises in the Marvel U!

mainsection.plot: 'THE TRIAL OF JEAN GREY' PART 4! - A surprise ally from one character's past comes to help, but is that enough against the most powerful army in the Universe?

As their space adventures continue, find out why Rocket Raccoon and Groot are quickly becoming the hottest characters in the Marvel Universe. - How does the most dangerously daring critter of the cosmos get the bad guys? With his two best friends: Guns and Groot! Rated T

mainsection.plot: The Magus has tricked the Guardians of the Galaxy into thinking they've killed him so that he might regain his strength. He underestimates the bond between Phyla and Moondragon, and Phyla gets a message through.

mainsection.title: Knowhere To Run To
mainsection.plot: The Guardians are assaulted on all sides by Shi'Ar and Inhuman. They manage to deliver their message to Crystal, who takes care of the Inhuman problem for them, but that still leaves them with the Shi'Ar, Starhawk, and worse to deal with.

mainsection.title: Earth, Overcome
mainsection.plot: The Guardians of the Galaxy have been swept to the future where they encounter the Guardians of the Galaxy. After the requisite pre-team-up battle, the two team launch an assault on the Celestial Engine in hopes of getting a message back home.

mainsection.title: Adam Magus
mainsection.plot: The detonation of the Inhumans' T-Bomb has torn a massive fissure through space and time. Starlord's warning from the far future has arrived too late to prevent it. But they might be in time to prevent the end of the universe. Most of the remaining Guardians head to Attilan, where they work to save the Inhumans' city from the rift (while rubbing in the fact that they warned the Inhumans that this would happen). Adam Warlock arrives with the Universal Church of Truth, preparing a spell that should prevent the Fault from expanding any further. But betrayal from one of the Guardians leads to grave consequences for the galaxy.

mainsection.title: Other Worlds, Other Wars.
mainsection.plot: The Guardians are shifting through time, and have arrived in the 31st Century to find another team of Guardians of the Galaxy, this time led by Killraven. A team member who used to be an Avenger plans to help them reach Dr. Doom's time machine and try to get home.

mainsection.title: Seconds Out
mainsection.plot: In order to prevent The Fault from consuming the universe. Adam Warlock had to graft a separate timeline onto our own. However, the only one he could reach in time was the future in which he would become the Magus... a timeline he'd worked hard to ensure would never come to pass. Star-Lord, Mantis, Jack FLag and Bug are rescued from the Magus' Universal Church of Truth by Kang. He's recruited the Starhawks of the many timelines who have already fallen to the Magus in an attempt to fight his influence over the future. The Magus is causing all future timestreams to merge, ensuring his reign. But these four Guardians of the Galaxy are anomalies that he can't foresee. Kang plans to send them back in time to the moment that Adam became the Magus. Armed with a Cosmic Cube, he tells them that they have to do whatever it takes to stop the Magus.

mainsection.title: Fault Lines
mainsection.plot: The Guardians of the Galaxy have stopped the Magus from conquering all of time, but they've suffered heavy casualties in the process. Cosmo, Mantis, and Martyr have fallen to kill the Magus - who was formerly their comrade, Adam Warlock. And on top of their grief, they have a new burden in the Fault, a rift in space and time created as a result of the War of Kings. Moondragon feels the grief that led Martyr to make the deal with the devil that returned her to life, but rather than give into it as Phyla did, she ries to rejoin the team. Star-Lord and the Guardians are now trying to explore the Fault, which proves to be a very dangerous enterprise.

Written by DAN ABNETT & ANDY LANNING Penciled by BRAD WALKER Cover by DAVID WILKINS A REALM OF KINGS ISSUE! mainsection.title: Damages
mainsection.plot: Major Victory was assaulted by Starhawk, and the team begins to investigate. This investigation is postponed when an explosion seriously damages the Continuum Cortex, leaving everyone stranded. The explosion also reveals Skrulls were disguised among the citizens of Knowhere, leading to immediate and widespread distrust of each other. Drax, man of action that he is, decides to take matters into his own hands.

mainsection.title: Beyond Belief
mainsection.plot: The Guardians are fighting against the Church of Universal Truth in hopes of saving a Dyson Sphere before it goes critical, killing thousands on it, and damaging space-time severely. They take heavy casualties, and manage to save the souls on the sphere, but only through a plan that depends on teleporting out at a moment's notice. Unfortunately, their remote teleportation technology in Knowhere is offline, due to the unexpected visit of Starhawk, who is unhappy with Vance Astrovik for reasons unrevealed.

mainsection.plot: - Rocket and Groot are the two best friends that anybody ever had. And they're also amazing at killing really big alien things/saving the Galaxy! Rated T

mainsection.title: World Enough and Time
mainsection.plot: Stranded on 21st century Earth, the 31st century Guardians finally have a chance to locate the anomaly that is ripping the past, present and future of the Universal Time-stream apart. But locating it is one thing--preventing it is something else altogether. Shocking twists and end-of-the-World action!

So, yeah--things have definitely be interesting for Peter lately. After that whole deal with the Black Vortex, he could definitely use some rest. But when you're the Legendary Star-Lord, and you've got bloodthirsty aliens on your tail, each nap could potentially be your last
